name: What kind of warranty or guarantee does Frasheski Construction offer on paint and finish work?

mainEntity.name: What kind of warranty or guarantee does Frasheski Construction offer on paint and finish work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction stands behind the quality of our paint and finish work. We offer a warranty on our craftsmanship and materials, ensuring that the work is performed to industry standards. Specific warranty details, including duration and coverage, will be provided in your project contract. We address any issues that may arise due to our workmanship.
acceptedAnswer.description: We offer a warranty on our paint and finish work covering craftsmanship and materials, with details outlined in your contract.
